_comment: PowerShell Gallery modules CI installs, each at exactly one version. Install through tools/psmodules/Install-PinnedModule.ps1; never write a version anywhere else (test/unit/PinnedModules.Tests.ps1 fails on one). .github/workflows/ps-module-updates.yml opens a pull request each week for any module the gallery has a newer stable version of. A version that must not be taken goes under `skip` with its reason ("0.9.1" for one version, "<0.9.2" for every version below one); the updater passes over it and removes the entry once the pin has moved past it.
